states.label: Connected
states.headline: Local Connector is connected.
states.body: This device is selected and passed the latest reachability checks.

states.label: Needs attention
states.headline: Connection needs attention.
states.body: The device is known, but one or more route or heartbeat checks are unhealthy.

states.label: Relink required
states.headline: Relink this device.
states.body: A fresh Local Manager authorization is required before privileged recovery can continue.

states.label: Choose device
states.headline: Choose the device to repair.
states.body: Multiple devices are available. Select the target before any recovery action.

states.label: Admin repair required
states.headline: Admin repair required.
states.body: User-safe recovery cannot complete from this screen. An admin must diagnose the break-glass path separately.

states.label: Verification pending
states.headline: Waiting for verification.
states.body: A recovery step was acknowledged. Success is not confirmed until same-cycle readback passes.

states.label: Recovery failed
states.headline: Recovery could not be verified.
states.body: The attempted recovery did not pass readback. No recovered status was applied.
